extensionDescription.message: Translate text with your own AI service. Select text and right-click to bring understanding closer.

optionsTitle.message: Connect an AI Service · Transight AI

tagline.message: A little closer. Understand another language, and another way of expressing it.

setup.message: Connect your AI service to get started

sourcePlaceholder.message:
Type or paste text here.
Let language bring you closer.

selectionHint.message: Or select text on a page, then open this popup

emptyHint.message: Your AI translation will appear here

privacyHint.message: Text is sent only when you translate

connectIntro.message: Bring your own API and put every language within reach.

baseHint.message: Enter the API base address, e.g. https://your-provider.example/v1, without /chat/completions.

keyHint.message: Encrypted with your unlock password; never Chrome-synced. Leave blank to keep the saved key. Unlock passwords are never sent to the AI service.

modelHint.message: Select up to 5 Chat Completions models, or enter IDs separated by commas. Each model sends a separate request and may incur API charges.

preferencesHint.message: Understand the world in your own way

consent.message: I understand that text will be sent to this AI service, processed under its policies, and may incur API charges.

guideConnectHint.message: Enter the endpoint, key, and model, then save your settings.

guideSelectHint.message: Select text on any ordinary webpage, then click the nearby globe-and-arrows translation icon.

guideReadHint.message: Read the translation in the on-page panel, or paste text into the toolbar popup.

noteHeading.message: Less distraction. More peace of mind.

note.message: No automatic page scanning, translation history, or analytics. It works only when you ask.

builtFor.message: Built for a world worth reading.

footer.message: Every language deserves to be understood.

copyFailed.message: Copy failed. Please select and copy the translation manually.

connectFirst.message: Please connect an AI service in Settings first.

enterText.message: Enter or select text to translate.

backgroundFailed.message: The background service did not respond. Reopen the extension.

fallback.message: This page does not support the panel. Your selection is ready; click Translate to continue.

selectionTooLong.message: The selection exceeds 12,000 characters. Please paste a shorter passage.

readConfigFailed.message: Could not read settings. Reopen the extension.

saveFirst.message: Save the current settings before testing the connection.

testing.message: Sending “Hello, world!” (a small API charge may apply)…

backgroundNoResponse.message: The background service did not respond.

readSettingsFailed.message: Could not read settings. Reopen this page.

invalidBase.message: Enter a valid API Base URL.

httpsRequired.message: The API URL must use HTTPS. HTTP is allowed only for localhost / 127.0.0.1.

invalidUrlParts.message: The API URL must not contain credentials, query parameters, or a fragment.

invalidModel.message: Enter at least one model ID; each ID must be no more than 200 characters.

invalidKey.message: The API key must not contain line breaks.

consentRequired.message: Please agree to send text to your configured AI service first.

emptyText.message: Enter or select text to translate first.

textTooLong.message: Text is too long. Keep it within $1 characters.

http400.message: The service rejected the request. Check the model ID and Chat Completions compatibility.

http401.message: Authentication failed. Check your API key.

http403.message: Access denied. Check your API key permissions.

http404.message: Endpoint or model not found. Check the Base URL and model ID.

http429.message: Rate limit or quota exceeded. Try again later or check your balance.

httpError.message: The AI service is temporarily unavailable (HTTP $1). Try again later.

invalidJson.message: The service returned invalid JSON. Check that the address is an API endpoint.

truncated.message: The translation exceeded the service output limit. Split the source text and try again.

filtered.message: The provider blocked this text and cannot supply a translation.

missingTranslation.message: No translation was returned. Check whether the model supports Chat Completions.

timeout.message: Translation timed out (25 seconds). Try again or choose a faster model.

networkError.message: Could not connect to the AI service. Check your network, API URL, and access permission. Redirects are not supported.

permissionMissing.message: Access to the AI service is blocked. Check this extension’s site access permissions in Chrome.

languageSaveFailed.message: Could not save the interface language. Please try again.

modelsLoaded.message: Loaded $1 models. Check one or more below; save to apply.

modelsEmpty.message: No available models were returned. You can still enter a model ID manually.

modelsInvalid.message: The service returned an invalid model list. Enter a model ID manually or check the API address.

modelsUnsupported.message: This service does not support GET /models at this address. Enter a model ID manually.

modelsTimeout.message: Fetching models timed out. Try again or enter a model ID manually.

modelsFailed.message: Could not fetch models. Try again or enter a model ID manually.

modelFetchHint.message: Uses the current Base URL and entered key (or the unlocked saved key) to request /models in the background. No source text is sent and settings are not saved.

selectionUnavailable.message: Selection translation is unavailable on this page.

selectionEditHint.message: Edit the source or choose another target language

modelNotConfigured.message: This model is not in your saved model selection. Update settings and try again.

partialModelsFailed.message: Some models failed. Other translations are ready below.

allModelsFailed.message: All models failed. See each card for details.

dragTranslation.message: Drag to move; use arrow keys when focused

vaultHint.message: Saved keys are encrypted with your local password. Unlock once after restarting Chrome. Forgotten passwords cannot be recovered.

vaultPasswordHint.message: At least 6 characters. Required for a new key; leave both blank to keep the existing password. Use a unique password, not your API key.

vaultResetConfirm.message: Remove the saved API key and its unlocked session? This cannot be undone. Other settings will remain. Enter your API key again to use an authenticated service.

vaultEmpty.message: No saved key. A password is required when saving an API key; unauthenticated services need no password.

vaultLocked.message: Locked — unlock to translate, fetch models, or edit the saved key.

vaultUnlocked.message: Unlocked for this browser session. The saved key is not shown in this form.

vaultMigration.message: A legacy plaintext key was found. Set a password and save to encrypt it. Until encryption succeeds, the old key is retained to prevent data loss and translation/model requests are blocked.

vaultPasswordLength.message: Use an unlock password between 6 and 1024 characters.

vaultUnlockFailed.message: Incorrect password or damaged key data. Try again, or reset and re-enter your API key.

vaultLockedError.message: API key is locked. Enter your unlock password to continue.

vaultMissing.message: No encrypted API key is available. Enter an API key before setting a password.

vaultMigrationRequired.message: Open Settings and set a password to encrypt your previous API key before translating.

vaultEndpointChanged.message: The API endpoint changed. Enter a key explicitly for the new endpoint, or remove the saved key for an unauthenticated service.

vaultOperationFailed.message: Could not update key protection. Please try again.

vaultInlineHint.message: Unlock here to continue translating. Your password stays in the extension.

targetLanguageSaveFailed.message: Could not save the target language. Please try again.
